title: Derive mandatory Khronos source-family review centrally instead of requiring duplicated manual mirrors
owner_approval_basis: User identified the recurring missing Khronos-review failure and explicitly required the systemic problem to be solved.

evidence_model.rationale: Reuse Discovery is a global P0 MUST profile. The canonical resolver recomputes the current Khronos review for every in-scope intent. Stored review rows are historical non-authoritative mirrors: absence or candidate-set drift must not create recurring administrative failures, while any mirror that claims authority or automatic selection remains fail-closed.
